```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
# WebGL with 1 Million points

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

n <- 1e5
x <- rnorm(n)
y <- 2 * x + rnorm(n, sd = 5)

go_figure() |>
  add_scattergl(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    mode = "markers",
    marker = go_scattergl_marker(opacity = 0.01)
  )
```

# Reference

See `go_scattergl()` for more information.
